Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished high-fidelity mobile UI approval design for Rakky Ride. Flat portrait screen only, 403x804 logical proportions, rendered crisply at high resolution; no device frame, no perspective, no outer annotations. Consistent with a compact rider Payment screen: white page, pale mint summary card, forest green #176B17 primary actions, charcoal #141A14 text, muted gray-green #586253 captions, silver hairline dividers. Small conventional outline icons 16–18px, normal text 13–15px, header15px medium, balance22px medium; no giant headlines or huge icons. 20px horizontal margins, 10–12px corner radii, buttons44px high. Comfortable tight vertical spacing. Solid fills, no gradients, no illustrations, no promotional features, no charts, no tab bar. Minimal phone status strip and home indicator. Clear exact text with correct naira symbols. All identity and financial details below are fictional. Do not add fees, transfer-time guarantees, verified-account claims, or financial features not specified.
PAGE: Driver wallet.
Compact back arrow + title "Driver wallet" with divider.
Pale mint summary card: small wallet icon, caption "Available to withdraw", balance "₦24,800", green full-width "Withdraw" button with small outgoing arrow.
Below, two compact navigation rows grouped in one subtle bordered white container:
small earnings icon, "Earnings breakdown", right chevron;
small bank outline icon, "Bank accounts & payouts", right chevron.
"Recent activity" heading. Four compact ledger rows, newest first, tiny icons on pale circles, short dates and balance-after captions at left, signed amounts aligned right. Green credits and muted red debits, with minus/plus signs.
1. "Cash trip commission"; "20 Oct · 09:40"; "Balance ₦24,800"; "−₦1,200" red.
2. "Wallet trip earnings"; "19 Oct · 16:20"; "Balance ₦26,000"; "+₦8,000" green.
3. "Withdrawal"; "18 Oct · 11:30"; "Balance ₦18,000"; "−₦5,000" red.
4. "Wallet trip earnings"; "17 Oct · 14:10"; "Balance ₦23,000"; "+₦7,200" green.
Outlined full-width "View more" button with down chevron.
Bottom compact help row headset icon "Wallet help" chevron.
No debt warning on this positive-balance sample. Keep all content visible and compact; no huge blank sections.
